how_it_works: src/phrases.py keeps the last max_buffer_words committed words.
It tries the longest rule first (word counts descending), left to right,
and replaces the matched run with the rule's text. Unmatched words are
typed as themselves, space separated. REST and OTHER are never committed,
so they can never break a phrase.
Edit this file and restart the demo - no code change is needed.
word_forms_note: applied to a single committed word when no multi-word rule matched
grammar_notes: ASL has no copula: there is no separate sign for 'am'/'is'. Signing ME SAD
means 'I am sad', so this module does not invent an 'am' - a rule that
expands ME SAD to 'I am sad' is only a written-English convenience and is
listed above as an example you can delete.
Signing order is preserved; English word order is not reordered.
no -> 'not' only inside a rule; a lone NO is typed as 'no'.
